summary: The round 1 fixes hold. Step 12 now branches on what the inventory found for each file, so a fresh setup that finds a file already there takes the dry-run path. The this-checkout alias cases run as dry runs, which `cmd_command` honours, so a missing file is never written into the tree. RUN_LINE, the loop test's pinned sentence and the replay standard all name every command form, and no stale copy of the old sentence remains. One low nit is left: the inventory's new list of the steps that read it leaves out step 8. Nothing here touches data shared with scheduled or queued work.

findings.title: Inventory's new step list leaves out step 8, which line 21 says reads it
findings.description: The R1-1 fix turns line 19's pointer into a closed list: "steps 5, 11 and 12 read it, and step 14 lists what a rerun checked". Two lines down, the same inventory item says its retired allow entries are found here and that "step 8 reports them as `stale`". So step 8 reads the inventory too, and the list now contradicts its own sub-bullet. The round 1 shape.md investigation (R1-1) counted only the steps that say "step 1's" or "inventory" in their own text, and that is how step 8 was missed.
findings.proposedFix: On line 19, either add step 8 ("steps 5, 8, 11 and 12 read it, and step 14 lists what a rerun checked"), or drop the closed list and keep "keep it for the steps below and for step 14's list of what a rerun checked", so a future renumber cannot leave it stale again.
